## File: facebookresearch_partnr-planner/third_party/habitat-lab/habitat-lab/habitat/utils/visualizations/fog_of_war.py

Prompts

```
["reveal fog of war on a top-down map from an agent's current position and viewing angle", 'draw a visibility line on a fog of war mask between two points stopping at walls', 'compute all grid cells along a line between two points using the Bresenham supercover algorithm', 'build a python module to reveal fog of war on a top-down map using agent position and field of view', 'test the reveal_fog_of_war function with a sample top-down map and agent position', 'draw a rotated agent sprite onto a numpy image at specified center coordinates and radius', 'create a birdseye view image showing agent position relative to a goal with colored distance bands', 'generate a top-down occupancy map from a pathfinder with optional border drawing and custom resolution', 'convert a grayscale top-down map to RGB using indicator values with optional fog of war masking', 'colorize a top-down map, draw agents on it, and resize to a specified output height', 'create a video from a list of numpy array images using imageio and FFMPEG', 'paste a foreground image onto a background image with alpha blending and edge handling', 'draw translucent red strips on the border of an image to indicate a collision', 'tile multiple images of non-equal size into a single composite image arranged in columns', 'overlay lines of text from an info dictionary onto a frame image with automatic wrapping']
```
